    expenses=[]
    for raw_line in content.splitlines():
        line = raw_line.strip()
        if not line.startswith('- '):
            continue
        # extract payer, paid_amount, description
        m = re.search(r'^-\s+(.+?)\s+paid\s+\$(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s+for\s+"([^"]+)"\.(?:\s*)$', line)
        if m:
            payer = m.group(1).strip()
            paid_amount = float(m.group(2))
            desc = m.group(3).strip()
        else:
            m = re.search(r'^-\s+(.+?)\s+paid\s+\$(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s+for\s+"([^"]+)"\.(?:\s*)', line)
            if m:
                payer = m.group(1).strip()
                paid_amount = float(m.group(2))
                desc = m.group(3).strip()
            else:
                # fallback for no-quoted description
                m2 = re.search(r'^-\s+(.+?)\s+paid\s+\$(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s+for\s+(.+)\.$', line)
                if not m2:
                    print('Could not parse line:', line)
                    continue
                payer=m2.group(1).strip(); paid_amount=float(m2.group(2)); desc=m2.group(3).strip()

        # extract owed list
        owed_match = re.search(r'Owed\s+equally\s+by\s+(.+)$', line)

        owed_part = owed_match.group(1).strip()

        owed_part = owed_part.replace(' and ', ', ')
        debtor_names = [x.strip() for x in owed_part.split(',') if x.strip()]
        expenses.append({'payer': payer, 'paid_amount': paid_amount, 'description': desc, 'debtors': debtor_names})
    return expenses
